## Honeycrumb 6: Kitchen Board
The owner runs the day from the **Honeycrumb Kitchen Board** sheet: paid orders arrive there, and staff change the `status` dropdown (baking, out_for_delivery, ready_for_pickup, delivered, cancelled).

Every minute this compares the board with the orders table; each change is saved and the customer gets a WhatsApp update. WhatsApp only allows free-form messages within 24 hours of the customer's last message, so older chats are updated silently (production would use an approved template).
